paragraphs: Incorporated in March 2005, Kwick Forensic Solutions Limited (formerly Kwick Soft Solutions Private Limited) is engaged in providing forensic science, evidence management, cyber and digital forensics, DNA forensics and law-enforcement solutions across India. The Company initially focused on software development, including 3D rendering, animation and simulation, and subsequently expanded into forensic science and training technologies. Since FY2015, it has developed and supplied end-to-end forensic products, solutions, tools and technologies for crime scene investigation, fingerprint science, cyber/digital forensics, social-media analytics and evidence management.

The Company offers a diversified portfolio of forensic products and services, including fingerprint and physical evidence kits, evidence collection kits, Mobile Crime Scene Investigation Vehicles, digital forensic tools, DNA forensic solutions, handheld forensic devices and rental services for forensic equipment. It also provides product demonstrations, operating training, installation and post-delivery technical support. Its customers include police departments, central and state forensic laboratories, fingerprint bureaus, crime investigation departments, police training academies, universities and other government and private-sector institutions. The Company also sources products from international and domestic OEMs and has progressively increased domestic procurement to support supply continuity and cost efficiency.

The Company is supported by R&D and quality-management capabilities, including a branch facility used for R&D, product demonstrations and proof-of-concept forensic laboratory activities. Its quality systems are supported by ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, along with registrations with MSME, DSIR and NSIC.

As of July 31, 2026, the Company had 33 employees on payroll and 12 employees on contract, with personnel deployed across administration, finance, legal and compliance, operations, R&D, sales and marketing, tendering and management functions.

Growing domestic sourcing network supporting supply continuity and cost efficiency.

faqs.question: How to apply in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Kwick Forensic Solutions IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
